content: Yosemite has granite cliffs, waterfalls, alpine meadows, and long hiking routes through the Sierra Nevada.
Gettysburg preserves Civil War battlefield landscapes, memorials, and interpretive routes for military history learners.
Arches contains desert stone arches, red rock formations, and trails suited to short hikes and geology exploration.
Acadia combines Atlantic coastline, forest trails, granite peaks, carriage roads, and sunrise viewpoints.
Grand Teton has mountain lakes, wildlife viewing, alpine scenery, climbing routes, and dramatic ridge lines.
Everglades protects wetlands, mangroves, sawgrass prairies, bird habitat, and slow water ecosystems.
Mammoth Cave includes underground passages, karst geology, cave tours, and above-ground river valleys.
Olympic includes temperate rainforest, Pacific coastline, glacier-fed rivers, and mountain ecosystems.
